items.title: Rust 1.100 Introduces Cargo Security Cooldowns to Prevent Malicious Dependency Attacks
items.description: Rust 1.100 will introduce optional security cooldowns in Cargo, giving developers a way to delay newly published dependencies before they enter projects. Scheduled for November 12, 2026, the release aims to give security teams and package maintainers time to spot malicious updates before automated builds pull them in. items.title: Cloudflare Detects Early Exploitation Attempts Targeting Two Leaked PHP Vulnerabilities
items.description: Cloudflare says it is seeing early attempts to exploit two critical PHP vulnerabilities whose details surfaced before the PHP security team’s planned release. The company has deployed an initial set of Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules to block known exploit patterns. Cloudflare says the rules are available to all customers, including those on free plans, […] The post Cloudflare Detects Early…

items.description: Ransomware operators used commercial AI tools to help plan intrusions, manage victim information and prepare extortion, according to a new investigation. But the systems they relied on also kept detailed records of their work. The flaw affects FortiSIEM 7.5.0. Fortinet released a fix in version 7.5.1, while version 7.6 is not affected, according to published reporting on the advisory. items.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
items.description: This story is developing and was written before PHP's scheduled 14:00 UTC release on October 21. Once the release is out, the affected and fixed versions below are confirmed by the official advisory. PHP will ship an out-of-cycle security release at 14:00 UTC today, October 21, for two critical vulnerabilities that its security team has rated 9.2 on the CVSS v4.0 scale but has not described.
